{{Quote|They threatened to make me program the bean juice boiler to detect the presence of impurities, and I'd be tempted (since, doing the programming, I could refrain from defining my own spittle as an "impurity") if not for the fact that they have me working on the pseudonet encryption.|Personal log of Celis Bol|<ref name="CA" />}}
A '''bean juice boiler''' was a device used for preparing [[bean juice]], a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|drink]] that was typically boiled before being consumed. During the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a [[Metatheran Cartel Tilnes base|secret base]] of the [[Metatheran Cartel]] trade alliance on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]] was kitted with a bean juice boiler.<ref name="CA" /> Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the events depicted in ''[[Metatheran Caution: Caaried Away|Caaried Away]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> the [[Caarite]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Celis Bol]] [[Water/Legends|spat]] in some bean juice prepared for the Cartel base's [[Overseer of Cartel Operations, Tilnes Special Detachment|overseer]] [[Ko Bas]] and was threatened with being tasked with re-programming the bean juice boiler to identify impurities in the juice as a punishment. Bol regarded this as a tempting proposition because such a task would have allowed the technician to program the boiler to their identity their own spittle as a contaminant.<ref name="CA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The bean juice boiler was created by [[Morrie Mullins]] and mentioned in ''[[Metatheran Caution: Caaried Away|Caaried Away]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure published in [[March]] [[2003]] that formed part of the [[Metatheran Caution trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] roleplaying campaign.<ref name="CA" />
